biocontainers.name: bioconductor-receptloss
biocontainers.summary: Unsupervised identification of genes with expression loss in subsets of tumors

biotools.summary: receptLoss identifies genes whose expression is lost in subsets of tumors relative to normal tissue.  It is particularly well-suited in cases where the number of normal tissue samples is small, as the distribution of gene expression in normal tissue samples is approximated by a Gaussian. Originally designed for identifying nuclear hormone receptor expression loss but can be applied transcriptome wide as well.
